automationNotes: Steps follow the doc order exactly. Section 1 (Fetch View ID, Property ID and Service Account Details) navigates to Google Cloud Console and Google Analytics — external steps performed on the doc URLs. Credential-dependent steps (entering client_email, entering View ID / Property ID retrieved from credentials) will fail without real Google credentials and are recorded as doc failures. Install section follows standard Marketplace install pattern. Configuration screen: both GA4 (Property ID) and Universal Analytics (View ID) options are verified and demonstrated — GA4 is clicked first, Property ID verified/entered (warnOnly), then Universal Analytics is selected; credential fields are warnOnly because real credentials are required. Save is warnOnly for the same reason. Webhook tab is warnOnly (conditional on app configuration). Dashboard Widget: navigates to stack Dashboard and verifies the GA widget. Day selection options are warnOnly (small cards, requires real credentials). Sidebar Widget: verifies Content Models in left nav, clicks New Content Type button (opens modal) → enters name → clicks Proceed → creates 'GA Test Content Type' with a URL field, saves it, then navigates via Entries top nav → + New Entry → selects 'GA Test Content Type' to create an entry. Widgets button verified before clicking, GA sidebar widget verified after. Doc says 'Marketplace icon in left nav' — automation uses App Switcher (docWarning).
